fact: ANATS and Airtel Tchad signed a partnership on 8 May 2026 under which ANATS will verify Airtel's customer data and interconnect the two systems to identify mobile subscribers, with the enrolment campaign due to start in the following days (Tchadinfos report).

ARCEP says SIM cards must be linked to an NNI issued by ANATS and that some are still sold pre-activated with no identity check, so operators Moov Africa and Airtel face possible sanctions for not verifying identities.
